name: lingdt-ocr-1.1
description: A large model developed by Ant Digital Technologies specifically for document parsing. Deeply optimized for this task, it features a compact model size and fast response times while delivering high-accuracy results for text, formulas, and tables in images.
zhDescription: 蚂蚁数科专门面向文档解析使用构建的大模型，针对文档解析深度定制，参数少，响应快，针对文本/公式/表格图片给出高精度的结果

agentIntegrations.name: Codex
agentIntegrations.description: Configure MaaS as an OpenAI-compatible model provider.
agentIntegrations.zhDescription: 将 MaaS 配置为 Codex 的 OpenAI 兼容模型供应商。
agentIntegrations.code:
model = "lingdt-ocr-1.1"
model_provider = "maas"

[model_providers.maas]
name = "MaaS"
base_url = "https://maas-api.antdigital.com/v1"
env_key = "MAAS_API_KEY"
wire_api = "responses"
